title: First Cech cohomology of an injective ModuleCat-valued etale sheaf vanishes
statement: Let Y be a scheme, Λ a commutative ring, and J an injective sheaf of Λ-modules on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let U be an etale object and let (V_i → U) indexed by an arbitrary set I be a covering. Write F for the underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. The first homology object of the Cech cochain complex of F on this covering [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex], formed in the slice category Over U with differential the alternating restriction maps, is zero. In Lean, for Y : Scheme.{u}, the ring, modules and index set may live in Type (u + 1).

source.place: Lemma Tag 03FC (lemma-injective-module-trivial-cech), positive-degree conclusion and proof; Lemma Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), second paragraph

proof.text: Use exists_injective_etale_ring_module to obtain a ring sheaf R, an injective R-module M, and an isomorphism e of its underlying abelian presheaf with the one obtained from J by forgetting scalars. This is precisely the constant-coefficient interface in the original proof.

Transfer injectivity of the sheaf of modules to its underlying module presheaf using injective_module_sheaf_injective_presheaf. At p=q+1 apply injective_presheaf_module_cech_cocycle_lift_max with hom universe u and coefficient/index universe u+1. CochainComplex.of_d identifies the differentials with differentialValue; ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff and ExactAt.isZero_homology give zero SiteCechComplex cohomology. The original etale comparison and remaining conclusion then follow unchanged. This replaces the invalid common-universe ringed-site acyclicity invocation.

Apply S.cohomologyFunctor 1 to the presheaf isomorphism e, transporting IsZero to the chosen-product Cech cohomology of J. Apply mathlib_complex_iso_exists to S and that underlying presheaf. Map the resulting complex isomorphism through the degree-one homology functor and transport IsZero again. The underlying presheaf of sheafCompose is definitionally J.obj followed by the forgetful functor.

proof_origin.place: Existing source argument, with V2 forced replacement of ringed-site acyclicity by presheaf cocycle lifting in universe u+1; no signature changes.

    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    (J : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) [Injective J]
    (U : Y.Etale) {I : Type (u + 1)} (V : I → Y.Etale) (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ U)
    (hcover : Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ Y.smallEtaleTopology U) :
    IsZero (((cechComplexFunctor fun i : I ↦ Over.mk (f i)).obj
      ((Over.forget U).op ⋙ ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj J).obj)).homology 1)
